title: [Master] -SubBilling BillingLine doesn't consider entries for usage date ranges crossing periods
summary: Fixed subscription billing to correctly include usage data entries whose charge periods span across billing rhythm periods, preventing lost billing and reconciliation errors.
key_points: Usage entries that span multiple billing periods are now captured entirely in one billing line
New GetUsageDataChargeEndDateCrossingPeriodEnd method detects entries crossing period boundaries
Billing period is extended to encompass crossing entries using CalculateNextBillingToDateForServiceCommitment
Prevents duplicate billing lines by starting the next period after the stretch point
Resolves reconciliation issues between billing lines and usage data totals
quote: entry's amount is billed in no Billing Line at all
